# League of Resident Theatres (LORT)

> > The League of Resident Theatres (LORT) is the largest professional theatre association in the United States, representing 75 nonprofit resident theatres in collective bargaining with Actors' Equity Association (AEA) and other unions.

LORT serves as the primary organization for professional nonprofit theatres across the United States, negotiating union contracts with AEA, SDC (Stage Directors and Choreographers Society), and USA (United Scenic Artists). The organization supports member theatres in labor relations, advocacy, and professional development while promoting equity, diversity, and inclusion in the performing arts.
